purpose: Ground public Physical Economics report generation in source-native uncertainty, revision, methodology-regime, and release-vintage semantics.

evidence: Census publishes separate standard-error tables for March 2026 HTOPS detailed estimates, including food sufficiency, household energy spending, difficulty paying usual expenses, price changes/stress, and transportation sufficiency.
Census also publishes source-and-accuracy statements and data-quality measures for March 2026 HTOPS.
census_htops_uncertainty.reporting_rule: HTOPS-derived estimates must preserve source-provided standard errors, suppression/quality flags, and source-and-accuracy regime metadata. A report may simplify uncertainty for readability only if the underlying receipt retains the exact source uncertainty state.

htops_methodology_regime.evidence: Census states that HTOPS used a longitudinal design during 2025 and transitioned to a cross-sectional design beginning in March 2026.
htops_methodology_regime.reporting_rule: 2025 longitudinal HTOPS and March 2026+ cross-sectional HTOPS are distinct methodology regimes. A continuous trend requires an explicit validated bridge; otherwise reports must present adjacent regimes as not directly comparable.

bls_cpi_revision_vintage.evidence: BLS recalculates CPI seasonal factors annually; seasonally adjusted CPI indexes may be revised for the previous five years. The February 13, 2026 update recalculated January 2021 through December 2025.
bls_cpi_revision_vintage.reporting_rule: For seasonally adjusted CPI, each report receipt must identify the vintage/factor regime used. Retrospective reports must preserve release-vintage values when evaluating what was knowable at the historical time; current-vintage revised values may be displayed separately.

bea_progressive_revision.evidence: BEA states that estimates are routinely updated as more complete and accurate source data become available, including advance, second, third, annual, and comprehensive updates depending on program.
bea_progressive_revision.reporting_rule: BEA-based attributes must carry release status and revision vintage. A revised current estimate cannot silently replace an earlier release in forecast/decision accountability analysis.

source_snapshot_requirement.reason: Official statistical values, seasonal factors, methodology, and public files can change over time. Reproducible reports therefore require a frozen evidence snapshot or immutable receipt set identifying the exact source content/vintage used.
source_snapshot_requirement.reporting_rule: Every generated report must bind to evidence_snapshot_id and source_receipt_set. Later corrections or source disappearance create a new report state rather than mutating the prior report.

uncertainty_semantics.aggregation_rule: Do not fabricate a composite standard error when component covariance/dependence structure is unknown. Preserve component uncertainty and classify aggregate uncertainty as unresolved or bounded unless a valid propagation model exists.
uncertainty_semantics.precision_rule: Rendered numeric precision must not exceed source-supported precision.

finding_boundary: This research establishes reporting semantics and authoritative revision/uncertainty behavior. It does not yet implement covariance-aware uncertainty propagation, immutable source storage, or report delta execution.
